story_title: As Technical Support Staff, I want to suggest alternative equipment when a requested item cannot be fully provided so that the Event Coordinator can decide how to meet the requirement

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an equipment requirement is unavailable or only partially fulfilled, when Technical Support Staff review it, then they can record a suggested alternative, including the equipment type, quantity and a note.
The system shows whether the suggested alternative is available for the event's dates before it is recorded.
The suggestion is associated with the equipment requirement it relates to and is visible to the assigned Event Coordinator.
The assigned Event Coordinator is notified when an alternative is suggested.
The Event Coordinator can accept a suggestion, which updates the equipment requirement to the alternative for Technical Support Staff to reserve.
The Event Coordinator can decline a suggestion, which leaves the original requirement unchanged.
A suggestion does not reserve equipment or change the requirement by itself.
Equipment that is available continues to be reserved for the event even while another requirement is awaiting a decision on an alternative.
Only Technical Support Staff can record a suggestion, and only the assigned Event Coordinator can accept or decline it.

test_cases.title: Technical Support sees an alternative's availability for the event's dates, cannot record more than is available, and records a suggestion that then shows on the line
test_cases.preconditions:
SPM77 Ring Light Showcase (1 Aug 2028) requests 4 Ring Light, marked 'Cannot be provided' (only 2 are in stock). Nothing else holds Podium Light (4 in stock) that day.
Data: run `npm run fixtures:spm77` first. Go straight on to SPM-77-TC02, and run the script again after it.
Logged in as Technical Support Staff (vikram.nair@connectsphere.com, password123).
steps: Open the equipment request for the SPM77 Ring Light Showcase event
On the Ring Light line, click 'Suggest alternative'
In 'Note for the Coordinator', enter 'Three podium lights light the stage as evenly.'
test_cases.test_data:
Event: SPM77 Ring Light Showcase
Line: Ring Light, 4 requested, Cannot be provided
Alternative: Podium Light (4 in stock), quantity 5 then 3
Note: Three podium lights light the stage as evenly.
test_cases.expected_result:
Step 2: The Ring Light line shows Status 'Cannot be provided' with 'Technical Support notes: Only 2 ring lights are in stock.' and a 'Suggest alternative' button.
Step 3: A 'Suggest alternative' form opens on the line with 'Alternative item' (empty, 'Choose an item'), 'Quantity' (4) and 'Note for the Coordinator' (empty). The 'Alternative item' list does not offer Ring Light.
Step 4: '4 available for these dates — enough for this suggestion.' appears under 'Quantity'.
Step 6: The message changes to 'Only 4 available for this event's dates.'
Step 7: Nothing is recorded: the form stays open and the line shows no suggestion.
Step 8: The message changes back to '4 available for these dates — enough for this suggestion.'
Step 9: The form closes. 'Suggestion sent to the Coordinator.' appears on the line, which now reads 'Suggested alternative: 3 × Podium Light — waiting for the Coordinator's decision.', 'Note: Three podium lights light the stage as evenly.' and 'Suggested by Vikram Nair' with today's date and time. 'Suggest alternative' is no longer offered on the line. The line still shows Requested 4 and Status 'Cannot be provided'.

On the Ring Light row, click 'Accept' again

Suggestion: 3 × Podium Light (4 in stock)
test_cases.expected_result:

open_questions: DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - accepting an alternative for a partly fulfilled item keeps what is already reserved: the original line's quantity becomes what was reserved (Status 'Reserved'), and the alternative is added as its own line, 'Requested', for Technical Support to reserve (TC05). An item that cannot be provided at all is simply replaced by the alternative (TC04). Not in the story's wording; chosen to honour AC8.

DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - an alternative that is not fully available for the event's dates cannot be recorded: the form shows 'Only N available for this event's dates.' and 'Record suggestion' does nothing (TC01, TC03). The story only says availability is shown; refusing means the Coordinator only ever accepts something that can be reserved.

DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - suggestions are recorded, accepted and declined only while the event is in Planning, the same window as Reserve (SPM-49), Update (SPM-50) and Release/Adjust (SPM-69) (TC10).

DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - only a line marked 'Cannot be provided' or 'Partially fulfilled' can get a suggestion, one at a time: a second can be suggested only after the Coordinator has decided on the first (TC01, TC07).

DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - the note is required (AC1 lists it), up to 500 characters like Technical Support's notes. The alternative must be another active catalogue item the event does not already request; the 'Alternative item' list leaves the others out (TC01, TC07).

DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - wording chosen for this story: button 'Suggest alternative'; form 'Suggest alternative' with 'Alternative item', 'Quantity', 'Note for the Coordinator' and 'Record suggestion'; messages '<n> available for these dates — enough for this suggestion.', 'Only <n> available for this event's dates.', 'Suggestion sent to the Coordinator.', 'Suggested alternative: <n> × <item> — waiting for the Coordinator's decision.'; on the Equipment tab 'Suggested alternative: <n> × <item>', 'Accept', 'Decline', dialog 'Accept this alternative?', 'Alternative accepted. Technical Support will reserve it.', 'Suggestion declined. The original requirement is unchanged.'; notification 'Alternative equipment suggested'.

DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - the Organiser and the Safety Officer, who can already read an event's equipment, see a waiting suggestion too (read-only, TC08). AC3 names only the Coordinator but does not exclude them.

RESOLVED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - Technical Support is not notified when the Coordinator accepts or declines a suggestion; they see the outcome on the Equipment request page (TC04, TC06). This follows the existing process: Technical Support is not notified when the Coordinator adds, changes or removes an equipment requirement either.

DECIDED 2026-10-27 (kchoongg) - a suggestion cannot be left waiting when the event leaves Planning: 'Submit for safety check' is refused while any item has a suggested alternative waiting for the Coordinator's decision, even an item marked as not required (TC11). Cancelling or postponing the event is not blocked. The Readiness tab shows such an item as 'Outstanding', with a 'Decide on the Equipment tab' link, so it and the safety-check refusal always agree; it cannot be marked as not required while the suggestion waits, and an item already marked so is shown as Outstanding until the suggestion is decided (TC12).
